The BSN Visa Cash Back Credit Card gives you up to 5% Cash Back when you spend on groceries, dining, petrol and other categories.
Cash Back is capped at RM15 per category per month for groceries, dining and petrol (capped at maximum RM45 per Cardmember per month).
